te: The role of the Ministry of Defence and the armed forces in helping people in disasters
se: Representatives of the disaster relief centres of the Ministry of Defence and the armed services explained how forces are prepared, air transport, and lessons from the floods in Hat Yai District, Songkhla Province, such as setting up a forward command post and a back-up radio system. The meeting was of the view that mechanisms for military–civilian integration, back-up communication systems and data on rescue volunteers should be developed.
it: Readiness and operations of the military disaster relief centres
Proposals: military–civilian integration, back-up communication systems, better rules for budgets and government advance funds, and a volunteer data system

te: Studying ways to develop an earthquake early-warning system for Thailand
se: The subcommittee discussed ways to develop an Earthquake Early Warning System, including feasibility, obstacles and limits, with representatives of the Thai Meteorological Department, the National Disaster Warning Center, the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation and earthquake-engineering experts from Mahidol University, and plans to invite security agencies next time.
it: Earthquake early-warning systems: feasibility and how to proceed
The disaster relief centres of the Ministry of Defence and the armed services, and the Armed Forces Development Command, invited to Meetings No. 3 and 4

te: Town planning and disaster-risk data, hearing from the Department of Public Works and Town & Country Planning and the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation
se: The subcommittee studied the role of town planning and infrastructure in reducing disaster risk, and access to risk data. A representative of the Department of Public Works and Town & Country Planning explained how hazard areas are used in town plans and building standards. A representative of the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation explained the risk map and data sharing between agencies.
it: Using hazard-risk data in town plans, water-retention areas and building standards for earthquakes, storms and landslides
Disaster-risk databases and maps, monitoring and warnings, including PM2.5 dust
Approach to studying an earthquake early-warning system

te: Heard water and climate experts, and approved a seminar on lessons learned from the Hat Yai floods
se: The meeting invited the Director of the Hydro-Informatics Institute and the Director of the Climate Change and Disaster Center, Rangsit University, to give information on water-related disaster management and related technology, and approved a seminar on lessons from water management in the Hat Yai floods in January 2026 (this seminar can be followed further in the 2026 archive, Meetings No. 1 and 2)
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted

Water-related disaster management, related technology and flood preparedness (inviting the Director of the Hydro-Informatics Institute and the Director of the Climate Change and Disaster Center, Rangsit University)
Seminar on lessons from water management in the Hat Yai floods, scheduled under this resolution, 15 January 2026
Appointment and removal of secretaries of the committee and honorary advisers, and appointment of advisers to 2 subcommittees

te: Lessons learned from the Hat Yai floods, Songkhla Province, and 4 working groups set up
se: The meeting noted the work of the subcommittees, such as a courtesy call on the Ambassador of the Lao PDR to Thailand, a meeting on upgrading the Ban Phaeng relaxed trade point in Nakhon Phanom Province, and the national disaster knowledge network project in Songkhla Province. It set up 4 working groups and discussed the floods in Hat Yai District, Songkhla Province, agreeing to draw lessons systematically, invite experts to give information and hold a seminar
it: Courtesy call on the Ambassador of the Lao People's Democratic Republic to Thailand, 26 November 2025, and a meeting on upgrading the relaxed trade point in Ban Phaeng District to a permanent border crossing at Nakhon Phanom Provincial Hall, 27–28 November 2025
Project to develop a National Disaster Knowledge Graph, piloted in Songkhla Province, and automatic weather telemetry stations for early warning
Petition about the issuing of a title deed for a plot of land in Phanat Nikhom District, Chon Buri Province, as the petitioner asks for a review
Study visit on whole-system water management, Chaiyaphum Province, 18–19 December 2025

4 working groups set up: area-based policy plans / improving the efficiency of Damrongtham Centres / integrating national disaster management / water quantity and quality management in Rayong Province

Lessons learned from the floods in Hat Yai District, Songkhla Province: the Director of the Climate Change and Disaster Center and the Director of the Hydro-Informatics Institute (HII) invited to give information, 17 December 2025

te: Received the matter of the Ban Non Muang overflow weir, Chaiyaphum Province, damaged again by flash floods, and asked a subcommittee to visit the site
se: Wang Takhe Subdistrict Administrative Organisation, Nong Bua Rawe District, Chaiyaphum Province, asked for help with the Ban Non Muang overflow weir, damaged by flash floods from the Phang Hoei mountain range 3 times in 2025, affecting more than 1,000 households in 4 villages. The meeting therefore approved a site visit by the disaster management subcommittee to Chaiyaphum Province from 18 to 19 December 2025
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted

The Ban Non Muang overflow weir, Wang Takhe Subdistrict, Nong Bua Rawe District, was damaged again by flash floods 3 times in 2025, affecting more than 1,000 households in 4 villages (request for help from the Wang Takhe Subdistrict Administrative Organisation)
Appointment of honorary advisers and advisers to the disaster subcommittee

te: The Provincial Electricity Authority and the petitioner invited to give information on the acceptance of work, and a study visit to Sa Kaeo approved
se: The meeting invited a representative of the contractor who submitted the petition and the Provincial Electricity Authority to give information on the acceptance of work, and resolved that the Provincial Electricity Authority should consider ways to help within the law, with the agency's interests as the main concern. It also approved a study visit to Sa Kaeo Province, 1–2 December 2025
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Petition from a contractor about the Provincial Electricity Authority's acceptance of supplies (both sides invited to give information)
Study visit, Sa Kaeo Province, 1–2 December 2025
4 persons ended their term; 3 secretaries of the committee, 2 honorary advisers and 2 advisers to the disaster subcommittee appointed

te: Follow-up on the road subsidence on Samsen Road, and on upgrading the Ban Phaeng relaxed trade point to a permanent border crossing
se: The meeting noted the work of the subcommittees, namely upgrading the relaxed trade point in Ban Phaeng District to a permanent border crossing, and the road subsidence on Samsen Road, Dusit District, for which the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation, the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration, the Metropolitan Waterworks Authority and the Metropolitan Electricity Authority were invited to clarify. On a contractor's petition about the Provincial Electricity Authority's acceptance of work, the meeting agreed to invite both sides to give information
it: Central Subcommittee: draft study report on an approach to area-based policy plans
Request to upgrade the relaxed trade point in Ban Phaeng District, Nakhon Phanom Province, to a permanent border crossing
An anonymous petition about the effects of illegal entry

Road surface subsidence on Samsen Road, Dusit District, Bangkok (the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation, the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration, the Metropolitan Waterworks Authority and the Metropolitan Electricity Authority invited to clarify)
Petition from a contractor about the Provincial Electricity Authority's acceptance of work, as the petitioner asks for fairness

te: A petition referred to the Committee on Law and Justice, and additional advisers appointed
se: The meeting noted the work of the subcommittees, and considered a petition asking for a review of the performance of duties of state officials in one area. It referred the matter to the Senate Committee on Law and Justice, which has direct responsibility, and appointed additional advisers and working group members
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Petition asking for a review of the performance of duties of state officials in one area, as alleged by the petitioner
Appointment of honorary advisers, advisers to the disaster subcommittee and working group members

te: Assigned to study the motion on solving the spread of blackchin tilapia, and the upgrading of the Ban Phaeng relaxed trade point, Nakhon Phanom
se: Meeting on 8 October 2025 (no meeting on 1 October). The Senate ad hoc committee on Senate affairs assigned the committee to study the motion to set up an ad hoc committee to consider solving the spread of blackchin tilapia. The meeting asked the disaster subcommittee to consider it, and asked the Development Subcommittee to study the effects of illegal entry and the upgrading of the relaxed trade point in Ban Phaeng District, Nakhon Phanom Province
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Motion to set up an ad hoc committee to consider ways to solve the spread of blackchin tilapia (assigned by the Senate ad hoc committee on Senate affairs)
Study of the effects of illegal entry by foreign nationals, and the upgrading of the relaxed trade point in Ban Phaeng District, Nakhon Phanom Province
Appointment of advisers, honorary advisers and advisers to all 3 subcommittees

te: Meeting 32/2568 · Committee on Administration of State Affairs
Noted the results of the bilateral meeting in Malaysia
se: The meeting noted the work of the subcommittees, noted the summary of the bilateral meeting and visit to Malaysia from 17 to 20 September 2025, and approved the appointment of additional advisers and working group members
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Summary of the bilateral meeting and visit to Malaysia, 17–20 September 2025
Appointments and changes of honorary advisers, advisers to the Central Subcommittee and the disaster working group

te: Preparations for the visit to Malaysia, and confirmation of the committee's staff list for fiscal year 2026
se: The meeting noted the work of the subcommittees, prepared for the bilateral meeting in Malaysia from 17 to 20 September 2025, and confirmed the list of advisers, academics and secretaries of the committee for fiscal year 2026, from 1 October 2025
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Preparations for the trip to the bilateral meeting and visit to Malaysia, 17–20 September 2025

Confirmed the list of advisers, academics and secretaries of the committee for fiscal year B.E. 2569 (2026) (from 1 October 2025), and changes of honorary advisers and members of the disaster working group

te: Follow-up on grievances from the “Senators Meet the People” programme in Phetchaburi and Prachuap Khiri Khan about farmland and electricity
se: The meeting invited the state agencies concerned to clarify grievances from the public received through the Senators Meet the People programme (lower Central group) at the end of April 2025 in Phetchaburi and Prachuap Khiri Khan Provinces, about ownership of farmland and lack of electricity. It noted the approaches to solving them, wrote to the provincial land offices and Damrongtham Centres of both provinces, and informed the petitioners of the outcome
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted

Grievances from the Senators Meet the People programme, Central group (lower), Phetchaburi Province (29 April 2025) and Prachuap Khiri Khan Province (30 April 2025): ownership of farmland and lack of electricity
Appointment of advisers, subcommittee members and working group members in the disaster subcommittee

te: Noted the results of the study visits to the Pluak Daeng Royal Development Study Centre and the groundwater bank on Ko Samet, Rayong Province
se: The meeting noted the report on the study visit of 21 August 2025 to Rayong Province: the Pluak Daeng Royal Development Study Centre (Dok Krai Reservoir), putting the Sufficiency Economy Philosophy into practice, and the Ko Samet groundwater bank project. It also considered a petition about restaurant rent and noted the draft programme of the bilateral meeting in Malaysia
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Draft Act on Facilitation of Licensing Consideration and Services to the Public B.E. ....
Petition asking for fairness about a rent increase for a restaurant and drinks shop in a state agency
Report on the study visits to the Pluak Daeng Royal Development Study Centre (Dok Krai Reservoir) and the Ko Samet groundwater bank project, Rayong Province, 21 August 2025
Draft programme of the bilateral meeting in Malaysia, 17–20 September 2025
Appointment of 1 persons to the working group studying a review of regulations and laws on disasters

te: Approved a bilateral meeting in Malaysia on town planning and national spatial planning policy
se: The meeting noted the work of the subcommittees' progress, such as the study report on area-based policy plans and the follow-up on water management budgets. It considered agricultural petitions from Kanchanaburi Province and a matter of land title documents, and approved a bilateral meeting in Malaysia from 17 to 20 September 2025 on town planning policy and national spatial planning
it: Subcommittees: draft study report on an approach to area-based policy plans / progress on the draft Act on Facilitation of Licensing Consideration / follow-up and evaluation of budget allocations for water management
Petition proposing approaches to agricultural development and problem-solving, Kanchanaburi Province
Petition asking to speed up the revocation of a certificate of use (N.S.3 Kor) for a plot of land, as alleged by the petitioner
Site visit to follow up on petitions received, Ban Khai District, Rayong Province, 11 September 2025

Bilateral meeting in Malaysia, 17–20 September 2025: town planning policy, preparing and enforcing the national spatial plan, and frameworks for physical development at regional, state and local levels
